summary:
Fixed KAFKA-20434 by adding preferred server-side assignor change detection to the group epoch bumping logic in GroupMetadataManager.consumerGroupHeartbeat. When all static members of a consumer group leave and rejoin with a different server-side assignor (e.g., from uniform to range), the group epoch is now correctly bumped, ensuring the target assignment is recomputed with the new assignor. The fix compares the current preferred assignor with the computed preferred assignor after member update, and only bumps the epoch if there was a previous assignor and it changed. Both test suites pass: kafka.server.ConsumerGroupHeartbeatRequestTest.testStaticMembersRejoinWithDifferentServerAssignor and org.apache.kafka.coordinator.group.GroupMetadataManagerTest (433 tests).</parameter>
